images.scene: Interior of a small empty shop at dawn, framed CLOSE from just behind one man in a plain shirt who stands with his back to the camera facing into the dim store, his shoulders and head large in the middle of the frame. The bare wooden counter and empty shelves crowd in tight around him and fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. Beyond him a shop window is blown out with pale white daylight. Only a shallow band across the very top of the image stays bright, pale and hazy, fading to near-white at the top edge. No signage, no lettering, no logos anywhere.

An old carbon-copy invoice pad lying open on a worn wooden shop counter, its thin duplicate sheet lifted slightly, a simple pen resting across it and a heavy rubber stamp with its ink pad beside it. Any marks on the paper are faint, blurred and completely illegible. The counter fills the bottom half of the frame and bleeds off the bottom edge. The wall behind and the entire upper part of the image are bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

An old mechanical cash register drawer pulled wide open and completely empty, its wooden coin and note dividers bare and clean, not a single bill or coin inside. Leaning against the register on the counter is a thick untidy stack of official-looking payment slips and forms. The register fills the bottom half of the frame and bleeds off the bottom edge. No readable characters anywhere on the papers or the machine. The entire upper part of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

A large antique blacksmith bellows of cracked worn leather and dark wood, hanging alone on the rough wall of an empty workshop, its leather folds collapsed and slack. Nothing else on the wall. The bellows fills the lower half of the frame and bleeds off the bottom edge. The wall above and the entire upper part of the image are bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

Close view of a man's hands signing a document on a wooden desk, one hand pressing the page flat while the other holds the pen mid-signature. Resting on the desk right beside the paper is an ordinary bunch of house keys on a plain ring. The writing on the page is faint, blurred and completely illegible. The desk and hands fill the bottom half of the frame and bleed off the bottom edge. The entire upper part of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

A small old iron safe standing on a bare concrete floor, its heavy door swung wide open showing a completely empty interior, dust on the shelf inside, paint chipped on the metal. Nothing else in the room. No dial numbers readable, no lettering on the safe. The safe fills the lower half of the frame and bleeds off the bottom edge. The wall behind and the entire upper part of the image are bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

Close view of a working man's large calloused hands, fingers interlocked, resting still on a plain scratched wooden table. Rolled shirt sleeves at the wrists. No face visible in the frame, cropped at the forearms. The hands and table fill the bottom half of the frame and bleed off the bottom edge. The entire upper part of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

A small improvised stage in a bare hall: a single microphone on a stand under one harsh bright spotlight, an empty low platform, and in front of it rows of cheap folding chairs, every one of them empty, filling the bottom third of the frame and bleeding off the bottom edge. No banners, no signage, no lettering anywhere. The upper part of the hall is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.

A man sitting on the edge of an unmade bed in a dark bedroom in the middle of the night, elbows on his knees, head down, awake. The rest of the house behind him is unlit. A man in a work apron standing completely still and alone in the middle of a busy city sidewalk, arms at his sides, looking straight ahead. A man in a plain shirt standing inside a dark empty warehouse at night, holding a flashlight raised in one hand, its narrow beam lighting only one small patch of the far wall while everything around him stays in deep shadow. He fills the lower middle of the frame and bleeds off the bottom edge. Above him the space opens out bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the very top edge.
